units.source_text: 莱蒙特在天上看见耶稣基督也是穿着类似那两个人穿的那种耀目的衣服。

en.t: In heaven, Lamont saw that Jesus Christ too was wearing the same kind of dazzling garment as those two men.

units.source_text: 不仅是基督，身在天国的人也都穿着用光交织成的衣裳。

en.t: Not only Christ, but all the people in heaven were wearing garments woven together from light.

units.source_text: 这些精灵把它当作是用自己的心灵织成的。

en.t: These spirits regarded them as something woven from their own souls.

units.source_text: 也就是说，人世间的精神生活，变成死后的灵魂的衣裳。

en.t: In other words, the spiritual life one lives in this world becomes the clothing of the soul after death.

units.source_text: 他们好像是这样认为的。

en.t: That seems to be what they believed.

units.source_text: 这种灵魂衣服的故事，包含着这个世界的伦理教义。

en.t: This story of the soul's clothing contains the ethical doctrine of this world.

units.source_text: 如同佛教的来世一样，在莱蒙特的天国里也有七界，随着灵魂的修行，灵魂就逐渐高升。

en.t: As in the Buddhist afterlife, Lamont's heaven also has seven realms, and as the soul continues its spiritual training, it gradually rises higher.
